players.product: MLCC dielectric ceramic powders (base and formulated barium titanate powders), incl. automotive-grade and AI-server high-end grades

quarterly_data.signal: General manager Huo Xiyun (Shandong listed companies' collective investor reception day): subsidiary Guoci Saichuang has technology reserves in ceramic substrates for optical modules, which are mainly used for heat dissipation; its TEC (thermoelectric cooler) products reached small-batch sales at some earlier customers while some new customers are still validating them; Guoci Saichuang's phase-2 plant is built and its capacity will ramp up gradually, and the company will keep accelerating development and validation of multilayer ceramic substrates for data centers.

General manager Huo Xiyun (Shandong collective investor reception day): the MLCC industry trend is good and the industry is expected to continue its recovery; demand for MLCC dielectric powders keeps rising and the company is accelerating capacity expansion of automotive-grade and AI-server MLCC powders to raise its market share. Asked about China's export controls on dual-use items to Japan, he said the policy changes bring new opportunities to its zirconia powder and blocks and MLCC powder businesses, and the company will actively seize volume-growth and price-increase opportunities.
